summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.88/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.88 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 21, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 2¢ higher than a week ago, 15¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.08 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.60) and the highest in Superior ($4.26).
